feeds.what: Media export: statewide races (US Senate, US House at-large, Governor/Lt. Governor, Secretary of State, Attorney General, Auditor, Treasurer, School and Public Lands, PUC), statewide totals only, one row per candidate
feeds.notes: Linked from https://electionresults.sd.gov/ResultsMedia.aspx ('Results Media'). No election id in the URL: the site serves the current election. Content-Type is 'application/text', Content-Disposition 'attachment;filename=Media.csv'. Header row then one row per candidate; every row ends with a trailing comma; PrecinctsReporting is written Excel-style as ="671/671". CandidatePercentage is a 0..1 fraction. Candidate names have doubled/trailing spaces ('Mike  Rounds '). Sets an ASP.NET_SessionId cookie that is not needed.

feeds.what: Media export: statewide ballot questions (4 constitutional amendments), Yes and No rows
feeds.notes: Same columns. CandidateName is 'Yes' or 'No' (CandidateID 9001 / 9002), PartyCode empty. RaceName is the full long title.

feeds.what: Media export: legislative races (35 State Senator + 37 State Representative contests)
feeds.notes: Same columns. RaceName is just 'State Senator' / 'State Representative'; the district is in AreaNum ('District 01', and split house districts like 'District 26A'). VoteFor is 2 for two-member house districts.

feeds.what: Candidate search list (names, party, office) used by the site's search box; no vote counts
feeds.notes: WCF service on sdresws.azurewebsites.us (answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). Not a results feed; includes local (municipal) candidates. ElectionID=0 means current.

election_id: The current election needs no id (Default.aspx, resultsCSV.aspx take none). Archived elections use ?eid=<n> on the HTML pages (a search result showed ResultsExport.aspx?eid=773 and SearchResults.aspx?ID=108); I did not confirm which eid is the 2026 general, nor that resultsCSV.aspx accepts eid.
discovery: None needed for the live election: the same three resultsCSV.aspx URLs always serve whatever election the site currently shows (the HTML header says 'Unofficial Results General Election November 3, 2026'; hidden inputs hidElectionType=General, hidElectionDate=11/3/2026 on Default.aspx identify it). There is no elections-list endpoint that I found.
cors: none on electionresults.sd.gov (resultsCSV.aspx sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin). The azurewebsites.us Ajax service answers '*' but carries no counts.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 on every request (Default.aspx, ResultsMedia.aspx, resultsCSV.aspx x3, resultsSW.aspx). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried. Plain IIS, no Cloudflare/Akamai challenge seen.
updated_field: No true last-updated field in the CSV. Column CurrentDateTime (example '11/10/2026 11:07:48 PM') is the server's generation time in UTC (my request's Date header was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 23:09:19 GMT), not the time of the last count; it lagged the request by ~1.5 minutes, so the export looks cached for a minute or two. The HTML pages I fetched show no 'last updated' text either.
reporting_field: PrecinctsReporting, per contest, as ="<fully reported>/<total>" e.g. ="671/671" statewide, ="43/43" for State Senator District 01. Default.aspx hidden inputs also give statewide hidPrecinctsReported=671, hidPrecinctsPartial=0, hidPrecinctsNotReported=0.

us_house: United States Representative (at-large; South Dakota has one seat, AreaNum is empty)
other_statewide: Commissioner of School and Public Lands
measures: Constitutional Amendment I: An Amendment to the South Dakota Constitution that Repeals Expanded Medicaid Coverage if Federal Funding for the Program Drops below 90%.
Constitutional Amendment J: An Amendment to the South Dakota Constitution Clarifying that an Individual Must Be a Citizen of the United States to be Eligible to Vote.

choice_format: One CSV row per candidate: 14412,"United States Senator","REP","","",110,,24967,"Mike  Rounds ",11/10/2026 11:07:48 PM,1,184589,0.605007505686623,="671/671",  -- party is the PartyCode column (REP, DEM, IND, LIB), name is CandidateName with stray spaces; a ticket is 'Larry Rhoden and Tony Venhuizen '. Measures: CandidateName "Yes" (CandidateID 9001) and "No" (9002), PartyCode empty.
district_field: Separate field: AreaNum ('District 01' ... 'District 35', house also 'District 26A' style). RaceName does not contain the district. AreaType is empty in all three files.
terms: none found (no terms-of-use or robots statement on Default.aspx, ResultsMedia.aspx or ResultsExport.aspx; the site itself offers the 'Media' exports for reuse)
